info.name: Meast — Service Offer Order Revisions
info.description:
Service offer order **revision** APIs (buyer requests changes; provider delivers or rejects).

**Base path:** `{{base_url}}/api/v1`

**Auth:** JWT `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (`auth:api`). Routes also use `validate.device` — ensure the token includes the expected device payload.

**Buyer** uses `user_token`. **Provider** routes require a complete service-provider profile (`service.profile.provider`): use `provider_token`.

**Variables:** `service_order_id` (numeric), `revision_id` (from list response), `delivery_version` (which delivery the buyer is revising, usually latest version from order details).

**Flow:** Order must be `DELIVERED` → buyer `POST` revision → order becomes `REVISION_REQUESTED` → provider `POST` deliver (new files) **or** `POST` reject revision.

item.name: Buyer
item.description: Authenticated **client** (buyer). List revisions and submit a revision request when the order is delivered and credits remain (from plan `number_of_revisions`).

formdata.description: Must match an existing delivery `version` on this order.

formdata.value: Please align the logo with the moodboard and increase contrast on the icon.

formdata.description: Optional. jpg, jpeg, png, pdf — max 5MB each (validation in app).

request.description: Requires order status **DELIVERED**, revision credits left, and no other pending revision. Sets order to **REVISION_REQUESTED**. Response is full order details resource.

item.name: Provider
item.description: Authenticated **service provider** (seller). List revisions, reject a request, or submit a new delivery while the order is in **REVISION_REQUESTED**.

request.description: Same shape as buyer list; provider must own the order.
Marks revision **REJECTED** and returns order status to **DELIVERED** (buyer keeps revision credit). Order must be **REVISION_REQUESTED** with this revision **PENDING**.

formdata.value: Updated assets per your feedback — see V2 in attachments.

request.description: When order is **REVISION_REQUESTED**, a pending revision must exist. Creates the next delivery version, marks the revision **ACCEPTED**, sets order back to **DELIVERED**. Also used for first delivery when order is **IN_PROGRESS**.

item.name: Reference (same order context)
item.description: Optional calls to load order context before/after revision actions.

request.description: Includes `deliveries`, `revision_policy`, and `revisions` on the details resource.
Provider view of the same order (deliveries, revisions, etc.).
